variants.specifics: Brackenford: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text: Ooooh, how could this happen? Those nasty Urchins knocked down both of my millhands. There's no time to run for help. Quickly, will you go after them before my Cloak of Mists is lost in the old barrow east of the ford?

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: My Cloak of Mists is saved! You'll need good boots for the climb up Crow Hill. Here, take these with you.

journal.text: Recover the Cloak of Mists stolen by the Urchins.

guard.speaker: Garrick
guard.text: Only Halvard's own men may pass this gate!

shop.speaker: Dunstan
shop.text: The ferrymen have doubled the fare across the river.

townsfolk1.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk1.text: The ferry below Wenna's mill will take you to the far bank.

townsfolk2.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk2.text: You look awful scrawny for a wolf-hunter. Hah, hah, hah...!

variants.writer: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), writer 1

variants.specifics: Ostrum: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Pellox
offer.text:
Truth is, trade has been rather poor lately. Ten days ago, thieves broke into my shop and emptied the strongbox.

I don't suppose my silver will ever come back, but I'd like nothing better than seeing those crooks pay for what they did.

I'll gladly reward whoever puts a stop to them.

completion.speaker: Pellox
completion.text:
So the thieves have got what was coming to them! Good work, lad! The whole town can rest easier knowing those crooks won't be sneaking their grubby hands into our strongboxes!

And here's your reward... 150 in gold! You'll always be welcome at Pellox's shop!

journal.text: Hunt down the thieves who robbed Pellox.

guard.speaker: Kettrig
guard.text: What are you doing here? The lift is shut by order! You'd best go see Foreman Dagrim if you hope to get below. The Ogres hold the Copper Deep.

shop.speaker: Zephrin
shop.text: What is it you want, Wanderer? I have work to do.

townsfolk1.speaker: Old Miner
townsfolk1.text: Dig, stranger, dig! Hee, hee, hee...!

variants.specifics: Vell: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Oswig
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer! Thank goodness you've come at last, for we sorely need your help. Grulga's Trolls swept through Vell only days ago and carried off the Staff of Binding! Will you go to the Troll caves to the southwest and bring the precious Staff back to me as quickly as you can?

completion.speaker: Oswig
completion.text:
Well done, brave Wanderer! My deepest thanks for bringing back the Staff! Now that we have it again, we can at last put an end to that wicked witch's schemes for good!

Here, these blue potions and this spell book should prove useful... more useful than you know.

guard.speaker: Torvic
guard.text: Lookin' to spend a night in the stocks?

shop.speaker: Bodo
shop.text: You've no business back here. Best get out of my kitchen.

townsfolk1.speaker: Fisk
townsfolk1.text: Hurry! Mayor Pellig is expecting you in his house across the village. There's a little boat behind the inn that can carry you over to him.

townsfolk2.speaker: Tansy
townsfolk2.text: Good work saving Mortimer, stranger! I hear Hesper is telling everyone about it!

variants.specifics: Tarnhold: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Wendle
offer.text:
Sorry, mate, the drawbridge is jammed! Only way to the south road is under the wall, through the Urchin den. But, if you go that way, mate, stay sharp! The Urchins swiped my helmet while I was napping on watch!

If you get it back, mate, I'll give you a damn fine spell book.

completion.speaker: Wendle
completion.text: My helmet! I figured it was gone for good! I owe you one, mate. Here's the spell book, like I promised.

journal.text: Recover the drawbridge sentry's helmet from the Urchins and give it back.

shop.speaker: Brokk
shop.text: Times are bad. Buy something, before I test this new mace on your skull!

townsfolk1.speaker: Dask
townsfolk1.text: March on, Wanderer. Your strength and the garrison's spears will drive back these foul Ogres.

townsfolk2.speaker: Mott
townsfolk2.text: Shouldn't you be off to Grael Gorge by now?

variants.specifics: Tolvin: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Ysolde
offer.text:
While I tend to the fishermen hurt in these raids, there's another errand I need run.

Corm, my brother, has sent word that he has finished the Staff of Mending I asked him to make. But nobody has heard a peep from him since the Urchins started prowling the east shore.

Under this house there is an old tunnel which we used to hide from raiders. It comes out at Corm's hut. Just stand beside the barrels at the back of this room and you'll find the way in.

Will you fetch the Staff for me and see how Corm is faring?

completion.speaker: Ysolde
completion.text:
You have the Staff of Mending! Wonderful!

But my fears for poor Corm have come true, I see. I will miss him, but there's no time for grieving now. Mayor Gorvane needs every able hand and he has asked to see you.

Take this Ankh for your trouble. Good luck, lad!

journal.text: Retrieve the Staff of Mending which Corm has made.

guard.speaker: Tobb
guard.text: No way through! Shove off, pest!

shop.speaker: Esmolde
shop.text: Hmm... Not the cheapest potions, I admit... But mighty strong all the same!

townsfolk1.speaker: Fisherman
townsfolk1.text: You're thinking of my brother, sorry.

townsfolk2.speaker: Maiden
townsfolk2.text: Ew! I saw one of those Urchins sneak right into the Mayor Gorvane's boathouse!

variants.specifics: Olvane: cross-section: bounty_offer, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Vimbly
offer.text:
These wretched bats are the bane of my life! The porters swung brooms at them, but they keep flying back in! My last hope is that you can somehow chase the bats out for good!

The bats are in my bedchamber, up there, behind the green door. Please, do be careful.

completion.speaker: Vimbly
completion.text:
Brave Adventurer, you have my deepest gratitude! You have earned the title of Friend of the College. Brunt and the other guards will be told that you may enter the College library as you please.

Take this gold for your trouble. I insist.

journal.text: Drive the bats out of Chancellor Vimbly's bedchamber.

guard.speaker: Brunt
guard.text: Stand where you are, stranger! Dobbo says you snatched a dagger off his counter and the bare hook on his wall proves it! Come along. I've got a cold and musty cell waiting just for you! Will you go quietly, stranger?

shop.speaker: Pumbric
shop.text:
Not from around here, eh? Most folks up at the College turn their noses up at outsiders, but they've never set foot outside these walls and I've been everywhere! What do they know!? Huh? Heh, heh, heh...

You're welcome at the Brass Owl anytime, sir.

townsfolk1.speaker: Fennick
townsfolk1.text: What're ya gonna do? Hex me?

townsfolk2.speaker: Ursin
townsfolk2.text: Olvane must not fall to Grelvin. Hold fast for the honor of the College!

variants.specifics: Fort Ostkar: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Osk
offer.text:
Where were you all this time!? We have a dreadful problem!

Overgrown bats and screeching Imps from deep inside the mountain have overrun the cellars under my infirmary. Good men have bled in defense of the fort's precious stores!

And one of those Imps flew off with my healing staff! Please, I beg of you! Get my staff back from the beasts and you'll be handsomely rewarded.

This key opens the cellar door behind the infirmary. The Imps' nest lies somewhere beyond.

I also have a potion which might prove quite handy. Will you help me?

completion.speaker: Osk
completion.text:
You are a true hero! A thousand thanks.

While you were down in the cellars, fighting the Imps, Brannoc came by, asking after you. He wants to see you in the Keep -- at the top of the hill.

Before you leave, please take this gold for your efforts.

journal.text: Clear the Imps from the infirmary cellars and recover Osk's staff.

guard.speaker: Tolvar
guard.text: Aren't you supposed to be off fighting Trolls?

shop.speaker: Gribb
shop.text: Pssst! Hey! Pal! Need a sword? Lowest price in the pass and they're forged right here in Fort Ostkar!

townsfolk1.speaker: Tibbet
townsfolk1.text: We must drive out Kragan! Smash his Trolls and take back the Upper Gate.

townsfolk2.speaker: Fenna
townsfolk2.text: There is a good inn next to Haskel's goat pens.

variants.specifics: Orvak: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Foreman Kessick
offer.text:
Where in blazes have you been!? We're in dreadful trouble!

Monstrous giant wasps and shrieking bats from the deep tunnels have swarmed the Ironvein Mine. Good miners have perished defending the ore of Orvak!

Please, I'm begging you! Drive those beasts out of my mine and I promise you a generous reward.

This key opens the gate at the mine entrance.

I also have a spell book which might come in handy.

completion.speaker: Foreman Kessick
completion.text:
Now that's what I call a hero! My sincerest thanks.

While you were down in the mine, driving out the beasts, Wendril stopped by asking after you. He said he'd wait for you at the Great Forge -- just south of here.

And before you go, here's some gold as your reward.

journal.text: Kill or drive off all the beasts in the Ironvein Mine.

guard.speaker: Tolvar
guard.text: The Imps are pouring out of the Cinder Caves! Mayor Dunbrak wants you at once!

shop.speaker: Zarna
shop.text: Not many travelers come through lately. Orvak isn't much of a holiday spot these days, what with cutthroats robbing every wagon on the road.

townsfolk1.speaker: Corla
townsfolk1.text: I thought heroes didn't mind a little heat. Try keeping out of the lava.

townsfolk2.speaker: Nissa
townsfolk2.text: I hear Warden Holgarth's jail got overrun with rats last week. Odd things happening around here lately.

variants.specifics: Torvel Cross: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Hulda
offer.text:
Please, help me, kind stranger! The Ogres have smashed up my house and one of the brutes is asleep on my magic cloak in the back room!

Bring it back to me and I'll be in your debt forever! Will you do it?

completion.speaker: Hulda
completion.text:
Thank goodness, you found it! How will I ever pay back such courage?!

What's that? A big sack of gold? Well, if that's what you want, please accept this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Retrieve Hulda's magic cloak from the Ogre in her house.

guard.speaker: Tobb
guard.text: Those Ogres never would have taken Fort Ulm if Oberik had been here!

shop.speaker: Gulliam
shop.text: Sorry, friend, but my cellar's run a bit low. Ogres on the road always make folks thirsty. Heh, heh, heh...

townsfolk1.speaker: Townswoman
townsfolk1.text: No, I won't go out to market while those Ogres hold the north road!

townsfolk2.speaker: Barmaid
townsfolk2.text: Hello, stranger! Come see me again once you're famous.

variants.specifics: Corvale: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Mobb
offer.text:
Filthy, greedy beasts! The wolves just moved into the woods by my pasture and are already making a terrible nuisance of themselves!

My name is Mobb. I am looking for my sheepdog, Bodger. I fear he ran off into a wolf den near here.

If you can find Bodger and bring him home, I would gladly give you my old bow. Come along, I'll take you as far as that miserable den past the north pasture.

completion.speaker: Mobb
completion.text:
Bodger's collar! Something dreadful must have happened to him.

Well, you have shown those wolves who is master. Maybe you would make a fine shepherd yourself. Hmmm... Yes.

Follow me back to my cottage. When you are ready, take the bow and quiver by the door. They are yours. We have a great deal to do before the Ogres come down from the hills.

journal.text: Find out what became of Mobb's sheepdog.

guard.speaker: Haldo
guard.text: You're awful scrawny for an Ogre hunter. Haw, haw, haw...!

shop.speaker: Grobbel
shop.text: You'd better be quick the Ogres could come back any minute.

townsfolk1.speaker: Hettie
townsfolk1.text: An Ogre just went by my gate! Watch out! He can't be far off!

townsfolk2.speaker: Pella
townsfolk2.text: You're not from these parts, are you? Too bad you're not one of Captain Brannoc's soldiers. I just adore soldiers!
